participant_task_checkpoint.native_author_acceptance: Author accepted queue cancellation when starting with the queued actor and successful entry with the target actor. A nonparticipant continuing to attempt queued interactions could not interrupt the scene.
participant_task_checkpoint.observed: Author reports many queued hydrant interactions fail preparation, while a single talk interaction is interrupted correctly. Retained last_error describes prepare_timeout, but successful later sessions overwrote stop/exit identity.
participant_task_checkpoint.reproduced: Targeted regression failed against the previous participant script: cancelling current work advances the backlog; cancel_pending then suppresses cancellation of the successor until timeout.
participant_task_checkpoint.policy: Clear the native waiting queue before cancelling the current task. Keep cancellation keyed to current queue identity and wait for two idle samples before readiness. Continue checking new queued/current work while the lease is ready. Restore original autonomy value and inheritance independently during cleanup.
participant_task_checkpoint.queue_preservation: No reliable supported queue-pause mechanism established. Author authorized cancelling the waiting queue as fallback; interrupted/queued work is not reconstructed.
regressions: Single conversation and delayed cancellation without repeated cancel spam
Queue-clear/cancel failures, autonomy inheritance restoration and lease expiry

overhead_visuals_checkpoint.author_acceptance: Visuals-2 marker/control-switch and bubble suppression reported working; nonparticipant bubbles also suppressed. Tested with household Zois.
overhead_visuals_checkpoint.native_api_evidence: AB1Player.PlayerSelectedFxComponent is exported as the selected-avatar Niagara component. UB1SpeechBubbleWidget is the exported overhead bubble widget. SetForceHidePlumbob appears in native behavior docs but is not exported, so it is not called.
overhead_visuals_checkpoint.marker_policy: Hide PlayerSelectedFxComponent only for members of the fixed active scene roster. Outsiders retain their normal marker when controlled; controlling a participant again uses its already-hidden marker. Restore prior hidden flags on Exit or if an owner leaves scope.
overhead_visuals_checkpoint.bubble_policy: Suppress overhead bubble wrappers and exported background/icon/portrait/text/switcher opacity across the local UI while a scene is preparing/playing. This includes nonparticipants, not only the scene roster or household. Preserve original opacity for restoration; author confirmed effective household rendering. No native lifecycle or global-setting changes.
overhead_visuals_checkpoint.cleanup: Exit/error/mod unload attempts independent presentation restoration. Failed restoration retries while idle; positive invalidity retires released objects. Restoration does not overwrite a value another owner changed after our last write. Optional visual failures never abort scene playback/participant cleanup.
regressions: Original hidden/opacity state and repeated sessions
Engine refreshes, replaced marker component and late nearby bubbles
Partial marker/widget writes and independent cleanup retry
Invalid native objects and foreign presentation changes
Outside-roster marker remains visible; moving an owner out of scope restores it and re-entry hides it again.
Animated wrapper/content refresh, separate portrait/background opacity suppression and restoration.
overhead_visuals_checkpoint.diagnostic: overhead_visuals stores bounded current counts/error; overhead_visuals_active retains the last active sample after Exit for diagnosis.
overhead_visuals_checkpoint.participant_only_bubble_limit: Current exported UB1SpeechBubbleWidget members expose no target actor/ID getter; FB1SpeechBubbleObjectData exposes only SpeechBubbleWidget, and the handler exposes ActiveObjects/WidgetPool without an exported owner association. No reliable supported per-Zoi mapping was established. Narrowing scope needs further investigation; recommend retaining the current effective behavior for the first release.

save_load_checkpoint.author_observation: Saved during a scene, loaded successfully and found participants standing at the same location. Author accepts shared placement and confirms autonomy was already disabled before the scene.
save_load_checkpoint.native_observation: Fresh runtime idle/ok. Retained roster identifies 20522/20526 as the last recorded participants. Read-only entity reflection reports bCollisionEnabled=false for those two and true for the other two household Zois (20524/20528). All four autonomy options are local false; author confirms the participant values were intended.
save_load_checkpoint.source_observation: B2 on_savegame attempts independent outfit/position/collision/autonomy restoration and returns an empty script state. on_begin resets the in-memory lease and recovers outfit layers. The original collision/autonomy restoration snapshot is not persisted for recovery after loading.
save_load_checkpoint.interpretation: Shared valid coordinates alone do not establish save corruption. Persisted scene collision flags are a concrete concern requiring reproduction/baseline verification. Save serialization/callback ordering and exact cause are not traced; prior collision values before the saved scene were not captured by this investigation.
save_load_checkpoint.status: Potential save/load cleanup defect; not fixed. Successful loading/accepted overlap is not comprehensive save-safety acceptance.
save_load_checkpoint.recommendation: Investigate restoration before public release. Exit scene mode before saving as an interim workaround. No gameplay settings changed during this read-only assessment.
